purpose: Small, reproducible sample of REAL de-identified pathology reports for the clinicalbert Modal endpoint's live I/O test (tests/integration/test_clinicalbert_live.py). Deliberately separate from the full 296-report population-scale F1 reconciliation already recorded in /mnt/results/quarantine_receipt.json.
sampling_rule: Per cancer type: 1 short-report (10th percentile by char length), 1 median-length report, 2 richest-entity-count reports. 4 breast_crc + 4 nsclc = 8 total.

upstream_provenance.breast_crc_source: TCGA-242 pathologist-adjudicated gold (Chow et al. 2026, Zenodo 20263861), reused from v0.5.0
upstream_provenance.nsclc_source: tencent/hy3:free LLM self-consistency annotations (min_votes=2 of 3 runs) over TCGA-Reports (Kefeli & Tatonetti 2024, Mendeley DOI 10.17632/hyg5xkznpx.1, CC BY 4.0)
upstream_provenance.individual_record_provenance_tag_seen_in: REAL-v0.5.0-tcga242-gold (breast_crc records) -- corpus-level manifest tag is v0.5.1; this is expected (test_breast_crc.jsonl is explicitly reused v0.5.0 gold per manifest.json 'test_breast_crc_source' field, not a discrepancy)

record_schema.source_corpus: which of the two source jsonl files this record came from
record_schema.source_index: 0-indexed line number in that source file (for traceability back to the original)
record_schema.text: raw de-identified pathology report text, verbatim
record_schema.entities: gold BIO-span entities: list of {entity_type, value (raw surface-derived, NOT canonicalized), char_start, char_end, surface}
record_schema.tcga242_file: original TCGA-242 gold filename when available (breast_crc only)

important_caveat: Gold 'entities[i].value' is the raw/near-surface text value (e.g. 'ER/PR IMMUNOSTAINS ARE STRONGLY POSITIVE'), NOT the canonicalized value the live endpoint returns in parsed[entity_type]['value'] (e.g. 'positive'). The live test therefore checks entity-TYPE presence/recall, not exact value-string equality, unless a canonicalization mapping is applied.
license: CC BY 4.0 (TCGA-Reports, Kefeli & Tatonetti 2024); TCGA-242 gold annotations per Chow et al. 2026 (Zenodo 20263861)
not_a_screening_claim: This fixture supports a ClinicalBERT NLP report-parsing endpoint test only. It is unrelated to, and makes no claim about, MedSigLIP mammography screening AUROC or any imaging ship-gate.
